name: frontend-artifact
body: An installed per-language scanner frontend, spawned by the scan driver: `gofrontend`, `rustfrontend`, `cppfrontend`, `csharpfrontend`, the `java-classes` dir, `tsfrontend/scanner.mjs`, `pyfrontend`, `mdfrontend`. It is the unit that carries build-time deps, scan-time deps, and an engine pin.
